## Summary

- What changed and why (1-3 bullets)
- Link to related issue or PRD section if applicable
- Note any user-facing or output format changes

## How to test

Run the relevant commands locally:

```bash
npm test
npm start -- --test shad-cn --iterations 1
```

For doc-only changes, render or preview the affected files.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (not required for doc-only PRs)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or credentials committed
- [ ] Ran `npm test` locally and all tests pass
